summary: Retain Smith-Njigba, McBride and Seattle for 4:05 p.m. Eastern.

sources.fact: Actual 28.68 to 29.70; projected finishes 110.5 to 154.5; three of our starters and six opponent starters yet to play.

expected_benefit.basis: Smith-Njigba has stronger season scoring and full practice; maintain expected points.

rationale: Hold. Jeanty has scoring upside, but there is no evidence that substituting him improves expected scoring. The projected deficit alone does not justify a swap.
missing_evidence: Final late-game inactive lists not verified; Friday Seattle practice report available. Detailed workload, league settings, waiver and trade queues not independently refreshed.
fallback: Check for late availability changes before 4:05 when possible; 7 p.m. scheduled check is after those locks.
